line: ASUS Zenbook 14 OLED (2025/26, UM3406GA, AMD Ryzen AI 300)
config_name: Zenbook 14 OLED — Ryzen AI 9 465, 16GB LPDDR5X, 512GB SSD, 14" 2K OLED touch, Win 11 Pro

specs.cpu: AMD Ryzen AI 9 465 (Krackan Point, 10-core: 4 Zen5 + 6 Zen5c)
specs.gpu: AMD Radeon 880M iGPU (12 CU RDNA3.5) integrated

battery.notes: 75Wh (UX3405 chassis). UBR long-term review of UM3406GA reports ~12-15h light use.

price.notes: BBY marketplace SKU 20076833, reg $2,149 sale $1,699 (2026-11-24). UBR notes UM3406GA AI 9 465 config is 'a far more interesting option' at ~US$1,000 levels.

offers.name: ASUS Zenbook 14 14" 2K OLED Touchscreen Laptop -Jasper Gray (AMD Ryzen AI 9 465/ 16GB LPDDR5X RAM/ 512GB SSD/ AMD Radeon Graphics/ Copilot+ PC/ Backlit Keyboard/ Win 11 Pro)

reviews.quote: what you can get in some regions is the Ryzen AI 9 465 configuration of the Zenbook 14 UM3406GA, available for around 1000 USD in the US at the time of this article. That's a far more interesting option at that level

praises: Ryzen AI 9 465 + Radeon 880M handles light gaming (esports titles at 1080p) far better than Lunar Lake rivals
Touchscreen OLED at this price is rare — great for scrolling and pen notes
75Wh battery gives comfortable full-day light-use runtime
Win 11 Pro included on this SKU
Crisp 400-nit HDR600 OLED panel praised for media
complaints: 16GB soldered RAM is the ceiling on this tier — no 32GB option
Marketplace seller stock — warranty/return experience varies vs BBY-direct

design_philosophy: The previous-generation Zenbook 14 chassis refreshed with AMD's top Krackan Point silicon — the value play of the Zenbook 14 family: near-flagship CPU/GPU at mid-range price with a touch OLED, at the cost of older styling and a 16GB RAM cap.
rating_notes: Ratings inferred from Ultrabookreview's UX3480KA/UM3406 coverage: AI 9 465 + 880M gives +1 gaming vs the 840M-reviewed config; touch panel adds pen_touch 6; brighter 400-nit HDR600 panel +1 readability_bright vs entry 80.
